answer.reason: The verses state two chief events of Miriam's life: leading the women in song after the Red Sea and being struck with leprosy for speaking against Moses.

clauses.english: led the women with timbrels and dances in singing to the LORD after the Red Sea
clauses.quote: Sing ye to the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously

clauses.english: spoke against Moses and became leprous, and was shut out of the camp seven days
clauses.quote: Miriam became leprous, white as snow

doubts: The Micah verse (MIC 6:4) and the Deuteronomy verse (DEU 24:9) only mention her sending or what God did to her, so they were not used as separate clauses.
Her death and burial at Kadesh is already in the summary.
